text:
Ivy: Quick weekend idea — Sunday morning bagels + competitive donut-eating doubles tournament on the patio? low-key prizes (bragging rights + ribbon). 10:30am? :bagel::trophy:
Marcus: Haha love it. can we also have a coffee brew station? I can bring my french press. :coffee:
Tara: I'm in for bagels but not the donut-eating round. I'll run a parallel crossword / chill table. :pencil:
Ken: Does anyone have a small portable table for signups and scorekeeping? I can bring a dry-erase board if needed.
Elaine: I'll do a baking-themed prize (handmade cookies) for the winners. also nut-free option available.
Ivy: Nice. @Marcus french press is perfect. @Tara crossword table is a great quieter alternative. @Ken dry-erase board please.
Marcus: Quick q: do we ask company for $100 for bagels + condiments or split? last bagel run was $60. :thinking_face:
Ivy: If we keep it simple maybe split or ask social budget for up to $120. @Ken can you check if small social reimbursements are ok?
Ken: I can check with finance. if it's under $150 we probably get approval quickly.
poll-bot: Poll created — Vote for donut format: 1) Traditional round donut 2) Mini donuts 3) Donut holes (fastest wins). React with :one::two::three:
Ivy: Also react with :busts_in_silhouette: if you're bringing a guest.
Marcus: :two: mini donuts are safer for layers. +1 maybe bringing guest.
Tara: :three: donut holes are my vote (less messy). no guest.
Ken: :one: I like a classic. also can bring extra napkins.
Elaine: :two: mini donuts and I can bring napkins in case.
poll-bot: Current votes — Traditional(1), Mini(2), Holes(1). Mini leading.
Ken: Facilities note — patio is cleared by 11:30 on Sundays so 10:30-11:30 window works. Keep music low.
Ivy: Great. I'll set up RSVP form and set a tentative event. title: "Bagels, Brews & Donut Doubles". If finance ok we'll cover bagels.
calendar-bot: Event tentative: "Bagels, Brews & Donut Doubles" Sun 10:30am 4 RSVP open
Marcus: I'll bring sugar-free syrup and a spare french-press filter.
Tara: I'll bring crossword printouts and a small prize for best team name.
Elaine: Count on nut-free winner cookies. :cookie:
Ivy: Perfect — current rough headcount 7 (including guests maybe). I'll post final RSVP tomorrow and lock down budget. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
